name: Recall Unread
description: 【实用工具】 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件：在模型读取前撤回已发送的文字消息，支持单条与全部撤回。A DeepSeek Harness plugin that recalls sent-but-unread text messages before the model reads them — one-by-one or all at once.
descriptionEn: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 插件：在模型读取前撤回已发送的文字消息，支持单条与全部撤回。A DeepSeek Harness plugin that recalls sent-but-unread text messages before the model reads them — one-by-one or all at once.
